review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The Role We are seeking an experienced Senior System Administrator with strong expertise in Microsoft infrastructure - Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Certificate Authority, and Group Policy - and in VDI and RDS access platforms . This is a hands-on role in a team that supports five data centers, several virtualization platforms, storage systems, the corporate Microsoft infrastructure, the VDI farm, backup systems, and cloud services. Hands-on participation in at least one completed Active Directory domain or forest migration, including migrating objects between domains and forests with minimal downtime. Fluent Russian and English language proficiency at B1 (Intermediate) or above for effective written and spoken communication.
